newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Crompton down after results.
newsitem.headline: India's Crompton down after results.

text.p: Shares of electrical equipment maker Crompton Greaves fell 6.75 rupees, or 8.4 percent, to 73.50 on the Bombay bourse on Tuesday after the firm announced a fall in its 1996/97 (April-March) net, traders said.
Crompton's net profit during the year ended March 31, 1997 slumped to 307.6 million rupees, from 640.4 million a year earlier.
Traders said the net profit fell sharply below market expectations though most analysts had recently lowered their forecasts after the firm released preliminary financial data.
Crompton shares fell 5.20 rupees to 76.50 on the National bourse.
